title: Bounded Sovereignty and the Control Tax: Pricing AI Oversight When the Deployer Does Not Own the Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.19216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI control research asks how to deploy models safely even when they may be misaligned, but many control protocols assume that the deployer can instrument the model and its surrounding pipeline. That assumption often fails for regulated organisations using frontier models through APIs or managed endpoints, where the deployer may control the business process but not the model weights, serving infrastructure, internal traces, update process, or full interaction logs. This paper introduces bounded sovereignty: partial technical and contractual access across the data, model, infrastructure, and interaction layers of the AI stack. It argues that these access conditions determine which control protocols can be executed in practice. translated_title: 有限主权与控制税：当部署者不拥有模型时为AI监管定价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19216v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：AI控制研究探讨如何在模型可能失准的情况下安全部署模型，但许多控制协议假设部署者能够对模型及其周围管道进行干预。这一假设通常不适用于通过API或托管端点使用前沿模型的受监管组织，在这些场景中，部署者可能控制业务流程，但不控制模型权重、服务基础设施、内部追踪、更新过程或完整的交互日志。本文引入了“有限主权”概念：即对AI栈的数据、模型、基础设施和交互层的部分技术和合同访问权。文章认为，这些访问条件决定了哪些控制协议在实践中可以执行。本文贡献了一个四层访问类型学、一个按层协议需求矩阵，以及“主权折扣成本”概念：即通过替代缺失访问所花费的控制税部分。
tldr: 本文提出“有限主权”框架，分析部署者仅部分控制AI栈时对监管协议可行性的影响，并引入“主权折扣成本”来量化替代缺失访问的控制税开销。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "bounded sovereignty" to analyze how partial access across the AI stack affects control protocol feasibility, proposing a sovereignty discount cost to price oversight when deployers lack full model ownership.
